exp: Almost all consumed fructose is metabolised in the liver as a substrate for de novo lipogenesis, leading directly to steatosis, and unlike glucose its metabolism is not insulin-controlled.

evidence.quote: Fructose is absorbed via portal vein and delivered to the liver in much higher concentrations as compared to other tissues.
